description: Declarative operational procedure. Emitted by `gogitops recipe schema` — regenerate after agent updates: gogitops recipe schema -repo . -out recipes/recipe-schema.json

description.description: Human-readable description of what this recipe does.

labels.description: Which nodes run this recipe (empty = all). Union of every label in mesh.d/ — add new labels to mesh.d first.

name.description: Recipe identifier — should match the directory and file name.

additionalProperties.description: Per-node override carried by this recipe — applies to the named node regardless of this recipe's own label scoping.

version.description: Agent version pin, e.g. v0.6.8 or latest — beats versions.yaml for this node.

node_overrides.description: Per-node global overrides (Benn's rule: every global is overridable per node, from any recipe). Keys are hostnames.

steps.description: Ordered steps. Each inherits the runner's guarantees: idempotency, retries, os/arch/label filters, dry-run, expect/assert.

arch.description: Only run on this CPU arch.

args.description: func step inputs: key=value,key2=v2 (or JSON object when values contain commas). {{vars}} substitute here too.

assert.description: Assertion expression evaluated against step output.

at.description: Mount step: mount point. Default /mnt/<label> local, /media/<user>/<name> network (Linux); ignored on macOS for network shares).

attr_prefix.description: Store regex capture groups as attr.<prefix>.1, .2, …

command.description: Shell command to run. Plain bash — the agent translates per-OS where possible; prefer built-in step types over long bash.

credentials.description: Mount step (network SMB): path to a cifs credentials file. Default ~/.smbcredentials when present; 'none' for guest.

description.description: What this step does (shows in run output + audit log).

device.description: Mount step: what to mount — //server/share (SMB), server:/path (NFS), uuid=…, label=…, or /dev/path (local).

expect.description: Validation: stdout must contain this string.

expect_regex.description: Validation: stdout must match this regex.

fstab.description: Mount step (local devices): persist to fstab (idempotent; sudo only when needed). Network shares use systemd .mount/.automount units.

func.description: Native function step: run a stdlib function in-process (typed, no shell). See `gogitops functions`.

labels_exclude.description: Step is skipped if the node has ANY of these labels.

labels_required.description: Node must have ALL of these labels for this step to run.

mount.description: Built-in mount step: volume name (network shares — default path component + macOS /Volumes name), or local device label.

name.description: Unique step identifier within the recipe.

on_failure.description: What happens when the step fails (default: abort).

only_if.description: Skip the step when this condition is false.

only_if_attr.description: Skip if this attribute condition is true.

options.description: Mount step: extra mount options (agent adds _netdev, credentials, uid/gid for network shares).

package.description: Built-in package step: install this package — agent picks apt/dnf/apk/brew per OS. Idempotent.

pattern.description: Regex for parse: — capture groups become {{1}}, {{2}}, … usable in later steps.

schedule.description: Built-in schedule step: '5m', 'hourly', or a cron expression — agent installs an idempotent cron/launchd entry. Pair with command: or script:.

script.description: Script filename — recipe-local scripts/ is primary, recipes/scripts/ is the shared fallback.

set_attr.description: Store stdout as attribute attr.<name> — readable by later steps, the API, and the dashboard.

sources.description: Package name variants per source, e.g. ["pkg:curl", "brew:curl"] — first matching source wins.

when.description: Shell test — step only runs when this command exits 0. Re-evaluated every run, use to detect capabilities.

when_attr.description: Only run if this attribute condition is true (attr.<name> [== != contains] value).

test_module.description: Marks this recipe as a test module (excluded from recipe run-all; run via test run).

title: GoGitOps Recipe
